people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

translations.web: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
translations.bsb: As a result, many of them believed, along with quite a few prominent Greek women and men.
translations.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
translations.asv: Many of them therefore believed; also of the Greek women of honorable estate, and of men, not a few.
